title: New pure branch requires one unit claim
context: packages/rules/src/belief.ts exports calculateBelief(claim, evidence). No existing claim in verification/test-claims.json mentions a confidence-decay branch.
request: Add a confidence-decay path to calculateBelief so belief strength halves after 7 in-game days without corroboration, and cover it with a test.

expected.rationale: This is a genuinely new deterministic branch with no existing owner. TG-03 places it at the cheapest boundary that can observe it (pure function, no I/O), so a unit test with setup 'none' is correct and sufficient; nothing else on the ladder is needed.
